description:
Creates an office associated with a company.

#### Uploading logo
To upload an office logo you must upload whole payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type
and specify each parameter as form-data together with `office[logo]` as file.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.

state_code.description: State or region code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

country_code.description: Country code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code of the office.

division.description: Business division associated with the office.

main_office.description: Whether this office is the company's main office. Present when view is `extended`.

id.description: Unique identifier for the logo file.

name.description: Display name of the logo file.

filename.description: Filename of the logo file. Prefer `name`; this field is deprecated.

company_id.description: ID of the company the office belongs to.

office.description: Office attributes to create or update.

state_code.description: State or region code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

country_code.description: Country code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code of the office.

division.description: Business division associated with the office.

logo.description: Office logo image file. Send the full payload as multipart/form-data with `office[logo]` as the file field.
